cantx.ask.p3: After an error (frame not acknowledged, settings other than the requested ones changed) the device blocks transmission by itself.
cantx.ask.p4: Disarming: the "Disarm" button, or flashing another firmware.

ota.ack.cantx: I understand the change of transmission on the car CAN.
ota.ack.mode: I understand the mode change and the conditions above.
ota.ack.nonet: I understand: the next update only with a USB cable.
ota.ask.p2: While writing, the device briefly stops receiving CAN frames and serving the radio; the sensor sound may break up. Flash while parked. If reverse gear or the sensors come on during the write, the device aborts it.
ota.ask.p3: During flashing and for 3 s after it the device does not switch off ignition, ACC, illumination or reverse because of lost frames.
ota.ask.p4: The CAN transmitter jumper on the prototype is closed: only the flashed firmware decides about transmitting on the car bus. Flash only images you trust.
ota.ask.title: Firmware update
ota.cantx.text_no: This firmware cannot transmit on the car CAN; the running firmware can. After flashing, vehicle setting changes from the radio will stop working.
ota.cantx.text_yes: This firmware CAN TRANSMIT frames on the car CAN bus; the running firmware only listens. Flash it only when this is intended.
ota.cantx.title_no: Firmware without transmission on the car CAN
ota.cantx.title_yes: Firmware with transmission on the car CAN
ota.car_busy_note: the car needs the device: flashing and rollback would be rejected
ota.chk.ack: The file is correct, but it differs from the running firmware. Read each warning below and tick it to continue.
ota.chk.changed: The running firmware has changed since the file was checked. Choose the file again (step 1).
ota.chk.ok: The file is correct. Continue with step 3.
ota.confirm_note: The new firmware is confirmed after about 20 s of running. Do not disconnect power until the panel shows "Done".
ota.conn_lost: Connection lost while sending. The running firmware stays untouched; try again.
ota.fail_help: What to do: unless the message says otherwise, the running firmware stays untouched. Check the file (step 1) and that the car is parked, then try again. If the device does not come back, reconnect to its Wi-Fi network: with a silent bus and no client for 60 s it falls asleep, and wakes on CAN traffic or when power is reapplied.
ota.mode.title: Operating mode change: {from} → {to}
ota.mode.to_decoder: Firmware in DECODER mode sends frames to the radio and switches the 12 V outputs (ACC, illumination, reverse). Flash it ONLY when the CAN box is unplugged: two transmitters on one line and two ACC sources short-circuit the outputs.
ota.mode.to_listen: Firmware in BESIDE mode sends nothing to the radio and does not switch the 12 V outputs: the radio will lose ACC and the data from the device if the CAN box is not plugged in.
ota.no_marker: The file has no marker of this device: it is a different program. Not sending.
ota.no_net_warn: After flashing this firmware, updates will be possible only by cable and there will be no automatic rollback.
ota.no_return: The device did not come back within 2 min. When the car needs the device, the restart waits; check the connection to the device network.
ota.no_return_short: The device did not come back within 2 min.
ota.no_return_wait: The device did not come back within 2 min (the restart waits while the car needs the device).
ota.nonet.title: Image without the network panel
ota.not_app: This is not an ESP32-S3 update image (a -merged.bin image is rejected too: flash the .bin without -merged).
ota.not_confirmed: DO NOT DISCONNECT POWER: firmware {version} is not confirmed yet (state {state}). Refresh the state in a moment.
ota.other.no_marker: firmware without the marker of this device
ota.other.not_scanned: not scanned yet (car busy), refresh in a moment
ota.pending_wait: Firmware {version} is running, waiting for confirmation (approx. 20 s; longer when the car needs the device)…
ota.rb.about: The device has two firmware slots. After an update the firmware that ran before stays in the other slot ("Other slot" above). "Roll back to the previous one" starts it again, for example when the new firmware misbehaves; the device restarts. The device also rolls back by itself when a new firmware does not confirm its first start.
ota.rb.cantx_no: The previous firmware cannot transmit on the car CAN; the running one can.
ota.rb.cantx_yes: The previous firmware CAN TRANSMIT frames on the car CAN bus; the running one only listens. Roll back to it only when this is intended.
ota.rb.mode_text: The previous firmware works in another mode. DECODER mode may be started only with the CAN box unplugged.
ota.rb.nonet_text: The previous firmware has no web panel: further changes only with a USB cable. Continue?
ota.rb.same: (THE SAME image as the running one)
ota.rb.text: Start the firmware from the other slot: {desc}? The device will restart.
ota.rb.title: Roll back to the previous firmware
ota.rejected: Rejected: {err}. The running firmware stays untouched.
ota.rejoin: If this takes long: reconnect to the device Wi-Fi network (within 60 s of its start; with a silent bus the device then falls asleep).
ota.restart_ask: Restart the device? In decoder mode the radio will lose ACC for a moment.
ota.rollback: Roll back to the previous one
ota.rolled_back: ROLLBACK happened: the previous firmware {version} is running. {what} was not accepted.
ota.rolled_back_short: ROLLBACK happened: the previous firmware {version} is running.
ota.s1.help: Pick the application image, a `.bin` file:
ota.s1.not: Not here: files with `-merged` (USB cable only) and files without `_wifi` (no web panel afterwards).
ota.s1.release: From a release: the file with `_wifi` in its name, in the same mode as the running firmware (`listen_wifi-…` or `decoder_wifi-…`).
ota.s1.title: Choose the firmware file
ota.s2.empty: Choose a file in step 1. The panel reads it here; nothing is sent yet.
ota.s2.title: Check the file
ota.s3.title: Flash and wait for the result
ota.same: This is the same firmware that is already running.
ota.state_unreadable: The device is back, but the firmware state could not be read. Refresh the state manually.
ota.title: Firmware
ota.too_big_slot: File larger than the firmware slot
ota.too_short: Too short: this is not firmware.
ota.wait_restart: Waiting for the device to restart
ota.warning: Flash while parked. While writing, the device briefly stops receiving CAN frames and serving the radio, and the sensor sound may break up; if reverse gear or the sensors come on, the device aborts the write.

sta.ask.p1: HTTP is not encrypted: any device on the home network that eavesdrops on the traffic can learn the device password. This password is also the key of the device Wi-Fi network and the only protection of firmware updates.
sta.ask.p2: Save the home network only when all devices on it are trusted.
sta.ask.p3: After saving, the device Wi-Fi will restart (approx. 1..3 s); while the engine is running the device does not connect to the home network.
sta.err_pass: Network password: 8..64 ASCII characters (an open network cannot be saved)
sta.err_pass64: Network password: 64 characters is a hex key in WPA2 (only 0-9, a-f); a text password has at most 63 characters
sta.err_ssid: Network name: 1..32 bytes, no control characters
sta.forget_ask: Forget the home network? The device Wi-Fi will restart (a break of approx. 1..3 s).
sta.pass_label: Network password (8..63 characters or 64 hex digits)
sta.title: Home network
sta.warning: HTTP is not encrypted: on the home network any device that eavesdrops on the traffic can learn the device password (it is also the key of the device Wi-Fi network and the only protection of updates). Save the home network only when all devices on it are trusted.
sys.backup.ask: Load the settings from {name}? Fields in the file replace the stored ones; fields missing in the file stay unchanged.
sys.backup.bad_file: This is not a settings file (a JSON object is expected).
sys.backup.done: Settings sent; the device stores them in a moment.
sys.backup.err.bad_value: A field has a wrong type or value: `v` and `vol` are numbers (`vol` 0–100), `lang` and `keys` are text, `net` and `lan` are true or false.
sys.backup.err.duplicate: A field appears twice in the file.
sys.backup.err.json: The device did not get the file contents (empty or longer than 255 characters).
sys.backup.err.keys: The key table in the file is not valid (pairs of hex codes `XX=YY` separated by `;`).
sys.backup.err.lang: The device has no panel language with the code from the file.
sys.backup.err.syntax: The file is not valid JSON.
sys.backup.err.unknown_key: The file has a field this firmware does not know (allowed: `v`, `lang`, `vol`, `keys`, `net`, `lan`).
sys.backup.err.version: Unsupported file version: the field `v` must be 1.
sys.backup.err.vol: The volume in the file is too low to be stored (a very low value would mute the parking sensor beeps).
sys.backup.note: A .json file with the panel language, the beep volume and the key table. Passwords, the home network, CAN transmission and the vehicle settings are never in it.
sys.backup.sending: Sending the settings to the device…
sys.backup.title: Settings backup
